## How to run (Windows PowerShell)

- Apply migrations locally (with PostgreSQL running):
```powershell
alembic upgrade head
```

- Generate future migrations from model changes:
```powershell
alembic revision --autogenerate -m "describe change"; alembic upgrade head
```

- Inside Docker (API container), you can run:
```powershell
docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head
```

## Notes

- The Alembic env reads DATABASE_URL from your existing Settings (services/api/config.py, .env). If not set, the `alembic.ini` fallback matches docker-compose defaults.
- Initial migration reflects the current models in services/api/db_models.py, including indexes and the FK from scraping_tasks.used_parser_id to parsers_cache.id.
